mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are holding steady at 61 degrees under partly cloudy skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. We are currently seeing a waxing gibbous moon, and please note the air quality is moderate with an index of 54. There are no visible ISS passes scheduled for our area tonight.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest is officially underway for Verona students in grades K through 12. Entries can include any artistic medium and must be submitted by July 22 to be considered for the November election. Once submitted, the community will be invited to vote for the winning designs from July 28 through August 7.

There is plenty to do in our area today, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market at the State Capitol. If you are looking for entertainment, you can catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join the fun at Hop Haus trivia this coming Thursday.

Looking at the police department weekly report, officers handled a notable incident on July 13 when they were called to assist a driver who had become stranded on a large rock, which resulted in an O-W-I arrest.
Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today. You are in for a treat because today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
